en: Emphasise the versatility: the Mira cape is a perfect substitute for a light coat or jacket, offering warmth and freedom of movement thanks to its open cut.
Draw attention to the fringe: this decorative element is a key trend of the season, adding visual interest and a premium feel even to the simplest of base outfits.
Recommend layering: suggest the client wear the cape over fitted dresses (such as Masuria) or knitwear ensembles (Matri and Marsan) for a status-elevating, cosy look.
